verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a dedicated Alerts feature and an MCP integration that lets users ask read-only questions like 'when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?' and 'are any of my connections broken?', which directly supports freshness/cadence monitoring. However, the evidence pack gives only a title-level mention of Alerts (no detail on configuring expected-cadence SLAs or freshness thresholds), and community reports confirm syncs do occasionally fall out of cadence requiring manual re-sync, showing the underlying risk this story addresses but not detailing the warning mechanism's granularity. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring per-table freshness SLAs/alert thresholds, and independent confirmation that alerts reliably fire before end-user pipeline failures.
